news.title: Nvidia shipment freeze and U.S. chip curbs put AI stocks under pressure
news.summary: U.S. export controls have halted Nvidia server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries and put billions in data centre financing under review.

news.title: New York Attorney General wins $1.4 billion ruling against founders of crypto trading firm NovaTech
news.summary: AWS Mining and NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddie Petion were ordered to pay $1.37 billion after defrauding hundreds of thousands of people, including 11,000 New Yorkers.

news.title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
news.summary: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.

news.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
news.summary: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

news.title: Switzerland approves 57 jurisdictions for crypto data exchange from 2028
news.summary: The Swiss Federal Council cleared 57 potential partners for cryptoasset tax-information exchanges beginning in 2028.

news.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
news.summary: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

news.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs on track for worst month on record as bear market drags on
news.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs have already hit record monthly net outflows of $5.39 billion in November, with several trading days remaining.

news.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
news.summary: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

news.title: Zcash developers want users to move $300 million out of an older privacy system

news.title: Europe’s only spot bitcoin ETF starts trading in Switzerland, BIT says
news.summary: BIT Asset Management's BBIT fund debuted on SIX Swiss Exchange with 350 BTC in assets and a 0.19% annual expense ratio.

news.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
news.summary: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: UK regulator plans tighter DeFi rules, citing $6.3B Binance hack: Report
news.summary: North Korea-linked hackers used DeFi protocols to launder stolen Binance funds, while US prosecutors moved to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto.

news.title: Fidelity files for Chainlink ETF, Musk’s X wins ruling in alleged bitcoin content-farm case, and more
news.summary: In today's newsletter, Fidelity files for spot Chainlink ETF; Musk's X wins ruling in alleged bitcoin content-farm case; and more.

news.title: Ripple is worth $90 a share to one fund and $300 to another, SEC filings show
news.summary: Two SEC-registered funds open to ordinary investors marked Ripple stock 70% apart on Sept. 30, and the lower mark sits barely above what the other fund paid in 2018.

news.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
news.summary: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.

news.title: Galaxy walks back bitcoin’s June-bottom call, warns of deeper losses below $58,525
news.summary: Galaxy now treats a daily close below $58,525, the June 30 closing low, as the start of a move toward a materially lower low.

news.title: 1Password hacker stole customer names and emails, but vaults safe
news.summary: The password manager, which is used by millions of people to store their login credentials, said customer vaults were unaffected by the breach.

news.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
news.summary: A bill to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote, but it faces a tight deadline.

news.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions

news.title: House Committee advances Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill with narrow path to passage
news.summary: The current 119th Congress is expected to adjourn in the coming weeks, leaving little time for full passage before the session ends.

news.title: LayerZero adds Samsung Card, Kakao Pay, ZAN as validators for upcoming Zero blockchain
news.summary: Zero uses ZK proofs to separate execution from verification, removing a layer of redundancy by leaving validators to only verify the proofs.

news.title: AI labs likely sitting on cryptography ‘bombshells,’ computer scientist says
news.summary: AI is driving a massive wave of mathematical breakthroughs which could have implications for cryptography.

news.title: Sens. Warren, Van Hollen lead push to scrap SEC’s Regulation Crypto and innovation exemption
news.summary: Sens. Warren and Van Hollen sent two letters to SEC Chair Atkins demanding he rescind the innovation exemption and Regulation Crypto.

news.title: Switzerland clears 57 jurisdictions for crypto tax data sharing
news.summary: The move paves the way for Switzerland to exchange crypto tax data with foreign authorities starting in 2028 as part of a global effort to combat tax evasion.

news.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
news.summary: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

news.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds

news.title: Fidelity files for spot Chainlink ETF with planned Nasdaq listing

news.title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk

news.title: Justice Department takes aim at billions in crypto fraud proceeds in historic ‘largest ever crackdown’
news.summary: Following President Trump’s directive to crack down on fraud, the Justice Department announced what it called its “largest-ever crackdown."

news.title: Nvidia agrees to $290 million settlement over crypto mining disclosures amid Jensen Huang turmoil
news.summary: Nvidia agreed to a $290M settlement over claims it misled investors about crypto mining demand driving 2017–18 gaming GPU sales.

news.title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook
news.summary: US core inflation rose more than expected in October as markets anticipate a December interest rate hike, which could slow a crypto market recovery.

news.title: Bitcoin falls toward $57K amid US tariff fears, hot PCE data as Nasdaq drops 4%

news.title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures

news.summary: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

news.title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
news.summary: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

news.title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
news.summary: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

news.title: Aave Labs publicly launches savings app as balances top $63 million
news.summary: Aave App supports bank transfers in the U.S., UK, and EEA, plus stablecoin deposits across eight networks.

news.title: UniCredit offers bitcoin exposure to Italian retail clients with capital protection at maturity
news.summary: UniCredit is giving retail clients access to bitcoin performance through a six-year investment with protected principal and capped gains.

news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 25, 2026

news.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
news.summary: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

news.summary: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

news.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
news.summary: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.

news.summary: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.

news.title: Bitcoin price may fall below $53K if bear-market history repeats
news.summary: Bitcoin price downside targets focused on the $53,200 realized price as research saw pointed to bear-market patterns continuing for BTC/USD.

news.title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
news.summary: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

news.title: HYPE drops 8% as Trump bump gives way to 40% slide from peak
news.summary: HYPE traded below its price before Trump’s August remarks as wallets linked to Abraxas Capital reportedly exited the Hyperliquid platform.

news.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
news.summary: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs from lows as markets bounce from big early declines
news.summary: The Nasdaq narrowed an early 4.5% plunge to just a modest loss, with Michael Burry announcing he's closed all tech shorts and gone long.

news.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
news.summary: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

news.title: Just 10 accounts drove all of the XRP Ledger's trading growth last quarter
news.summary: Data shows that the ten busiest accounts accounted for more than all of the exchange's quarterly growth, while trading by everyone else declined.

news.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
news.summary: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.

news.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
news.summary: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside custodian holds the coins.

news.title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
news.summary: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.

news.title: Utah moves to drop criminal pursuit of Kalshi after the firm halted services there
news.summary: The state continues to hold the criminal charges in its back pocket with a vow to hit Kalshi and other prediction markets with gambling accusations if they return.
